clue.text: Band needs to rent following second-class career

parts.note: B is the grade label for second class

to let a property is to rent it out

explanation.surface: Someone must hire out property after a mediocre working life.
explanation.definitionFit: A bracelet is a decorative ring worn round the wrist, a kind of band.

clue.text: Raised pace shown by favourites

explanation.definitionFit: Pets are favoured people, as in teacher's pets, so the plural matches favourites.

clue.text: Tests, for example, in a ship

explanation.surface: Trials, for instance, carried out aboard a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Assays are analytical tests of a substance's composition or quality.

clue.text: Worries about Germany having fighting units

clue.text: Hit high and short — into window!

clue.text: Orders forecasts, ignoring public relations

clue.text: Completely sound

explanation.definitionFit: Plumb is informal for totally, and also means to measure depth with a lead line.

clue.text: Fruit needed in a mainly noisy party?

clue.text: Followed son and confessed

parts.note: a suspect who talked has confessed

clue.text: Takeovers put the squeeze around working vouchers

clue.text: Lycra, deployed originally in cycling material

clue.text: Sort of water found in island church

clue.text: Dig up one-time Spanish drink with them, oddly

explanation.definitionFit: To excavate is to dig out earth, as on an archaeological site.

clue.text: Down when up on day

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I arrived'

clue.text: Parts of cooker for fictional creatures

clue.text: Backs objectives including the renovation of Eros

clue.text: Meat company during prohibition

clue.text: Destined to follow obscure conservative
